scenario.rule: capability labels alone do not instantiate different real platforms

demand.rule: record even if no request/message is generated; supersession preserves history

message.rule: protocol dissemination recipients and task consumers are different fields

transmission.rule: cost each actual attempt/hop; one broadcast not multiplied by receiver count

delivery.rule: ACK/header does not substitute body; applied_to_cache does not prove use

consumption.rule: feature read/receipt alone is not causal usefulness; explicit function logs record actual invocation

task_outcome.rule: all external task goals retained including unrequested/rejected/unfinished work

cost.rule: application serialization cannot be called measured airtime; zero-completion cost ratio remains null

comparability.fixed_replay: common externally specified innovations/demand catalog and geometry; generation may vary only in designated experiment
comparability.closed_loop: common scene/task goals and exogenous random field; requests and consumption times may diverge and are reported
comparability.information: local observation and delivered body only; evaluator truth cannot enter online decisions

growth_families.hold: declared spatial density and per_node radio hardware
growth_families.purpose: work carrying capacity with spatial reuse accounted

growth_families.hold: task goal set and declared capability feasibility

comparability.network_rule: freeze concrete radio/PHY/MAC/retry/routing configuration before demand expansion; actual contention/queueing/delivery are outputs
no_injected_stress_for_main_evidence: no chosen delay or loss used as primary cause
no assumed fixed total network capacity under area expansion
comparability.baseline_rule: include existing reasonable locality/subscription, compression, class queues, rate limits and recovery as applicable; equal information and tuning

common_missing_values: payload encoder and measured size distribution
fixed wireless configuration or clearly labeled application service model
task success definition and horizon rule
